user.title: Connect myBKW
user.description:
1. Open [this login link]({login_url}) and log in to myBKW.
2. You land on a page with a small arrow. Copy that page's full address from the address bar.
3. Paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to myBKW again
reauth_confirm.description:
The saved login has expired.

1. Open [this login link]({login_url}) and log in to myBKW.
2. You land on a page with a small arrow. Copy that page's full address from the address bar.
3. Paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: The login was refused. Open the link again and paste the new address within a minute.

abort.already_configured: This metering point is already set up.
abort.no_metering_points: This myBKW account has no metering point.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This login belongs to a different metering point.

init.title: Electricity price
init.description: Imported consumption is costed at this price per kWh. Choose a price sensor or enter a fixed price, not both. Hours are priced when they are imported, normally the next day; the history already imported gets the price that applies now. Fixed fees such as base tariffs and metering are spread evenly over the hours.

error.one_price: Choose either a price sensor or a fixed price.
